target.title: Target
target.description: The copy a build would assemble; null when every copy is built.

copies.title: Copies
copies.description: Copies acquired from this source (history: may exceed what is owned today).

pledged.title: Pledged
pledged.description: finish -> copies pledged to built decks

treatment.title: Treatment
treatment.description: Treatment codes (b, fa, shw, ext, sm, ff; '|'-joined); '' = plain

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Source keys this owned printing's copies were acquired from (see CollectionOut.sources).

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.description: Codes that didn't resolve to a family.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Every source behind an owned printing in this view, most printings first.

cached.title: Cached
cached.description: EDHREC commander page already in the local cache.

label.title: Label
label.description: Free text recorded on the ingest event (e.g. a deck name).

oracle_tags.title: Oracle Tags
oracle_tags.description: Top Tagger oracle tags by weight.

pledged_here.title: Pledged Here
pledged_here.description: Copies of this printing pledged to THIS deck (any finish).

free.title: Free
free.description: Copies you own that no deck has pledged (any finish).

version_id.title: Version Id
version_id.description: Current version; pass back as expected_version_id when saving.

editable.title: Editable
editable.description: False for precons (read-only recipes): copy the deck to edit it.

deck_type.title: Deck Type
deck_type.description: What kind of deck: the game format (Commander, Standard, Pauper, Jumpstart…), else the precon product family (Starter / intro, Secret Lair, Land pack…).

state.title: State
state.description: 'built' when at least one copy is built, else 'deconstructed'.

built.title: Built
built.description: Copies of this recipe kept assembled (cards pledged).

slugs.title: Slugs
slugs.description: Every deck row that is a copy of this recipe; `slug` is the representative (a built copy first).

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: precon = MTGJSON product; import = deck-builder URL; custom = hand-built.

source.title: Source
source.description: Deck builder for imports (moxfield, archidekt…); precon product type for precons.

released.title: Released
released.description: Product release date (precons) or set release date; ISO.

value_usd.title: Value Usd
value_usd.description: Sum of non-token cards at their finish's price.

pledged_pct.title: Pledged Pct
pledged_pct.description: Share of non-token card copies currently pledged to this deck (0–100).

image_uri.title: Image Uri
image_uri.description: Representative art: the commander, else the priciest card.

sets.title: Sets
sets.description: Member sets with printings, oldest first.

FunctionRootOut.title: FunctionRootOut
FunctionRootOut.description: A curated function root (``config/function_tags.toml``), in display order.

pledged.title: Pledged
pledged.description: finish -> copies pledged to built decks

free.title: Free
free.description: finish -> owned copies no deck has pledged

other_printings_owned.title: Other Printings Owned
other_printings_owned.description: Copies of the same card owned in other printings (all finishes).

commander.title: Commander
commander.description: scryfall_id of the commander to seed.

OracleTagOut.title: OracleTagOut
OracleTagOut.description: A Scryfall Tagger oracle tag (``id`` is the stable UUID).

swap.description: Physical swap list; only for a built deck.

treatment.title: Treatment
treatment.description: treatments.compute_treatment code, '' for a standard frame.

owned.title: Owned
owned.description: Copies you already own, per finish.

free.title: Free
free.description: Owned copies no built deck has pledged (all finishes).

PrintingOut.description: One exact printing a line can resolve to (what the picker shows).

line.title: Line
line.description: 1-based line number in the pasted text (0 for fetched decks).

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.description: Exact: one. Ambiguous: every printing of the name, best guess first. Unresolved: empty.

chosen.title: Chosen
chosen.description: scryfall_id of the default pick (None when unresolved).

swap.description: Physical swap list; only for a built deck.

version_number.title: Version Number
version_number.description: New version number; null when nothing changed.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: deck = playable precon; pool = card pool (land pack, scene box, most Secret Lair drops); singles = bought/added individually; unknown = provenance not reconstructed.

printings.title: Printings
printings.description: Owned printings in this view acquired from this source.

owned.title: Owned
owned.description: Copies owned across every printing of the card.

free.title: Free
free.description: Owned copies no built deck has pledged, across printings.

pull.title: Pull
pull.description: Copies to take out of the built deck (they return to the free pool).

sleeve.title: Sleeve
sleeve.description: Free copies to put into the built deck (pledged).

short.title: Short
short.description: Copies the deck needs that you don't have free.
